title: Weak-Form Recovery of Stochastic Generators
summary: Data-driven discovery of governing equations is well developed for deterministic systems but much less so for stochastic ones. We present a sparse-symbolic algorithm that recovers both the drift $b(x)$ and the diffusion $a(x)$ of a stochastic differential equation from a single discretely sampled trajectory. It replaces the time-indexed test functions of weak-form SINDy with state-dependent spatial kernels.
